name: Matsuricon
blurb: Ohio's largest non-profit anime convention: a three-day celebration of anime, gaming, cosplay and Japanese pop culture in Columbus.
notes: The site still shows Matsuricon 2026 (September 4-6, 2026, Greater Columbus Convention Center), which already ended before the research window, and explicitly flags itself as not yet updated: 'Some info still wears last year's mask—new updates are blooming soon.' No dates, venue or guests have been announced for the next edition as of 2026-10-05, so editions is empty.
